hits.title: Lior Veylan
hits.text: Raised as a moisture farmer on the desert planet Sovar, Lior joins the Freeworld Concord and becomes a pivotal figure in its struggle against the Vastran Dominion. He trains as a Vaelari Knight under the Vaelari Masters Orven Tal and Ulmor, and eventually confronts his father, the Nerathi Lord Vhar Kordane. Years later, Lior trains his nephew Renik Darell and mentors the scavenger Zerra. Lior is the twin brother of Nira Solenne.

Raised as a moisture farmer on the desert planet Sovar, Lior joins the Freeworld Concord and becomes a pivotal figure in its struggle against the Vastran Dominion. He trains as a Vaelari Knight under the Vaelari Masters Orven Tal and Ulmor, and eventually confronts his father, the Nerathi Lord Vhar Kordane. Years later, Lior trains his nephew Renik Darell and mentors the scavenger Zerra. Lior is the twin brother of Nira Solenne.

hits.title: Lior Veylan
hits.text: Lior changes his mind when he finds that Dominion armored legionaries have killed his aunt and uncle. He and Orven travel to Namar Port, where they meet the smugglers Taren Darell and Ruvakka. They hire the duo to take them to Elaris on the Vesper Kite, only to discover that it has been destroyed by the Abyss Sphere, the Dominion's battle station. The Kite is brought to the Abyss Sphere via capture beam, and Lior and Taren disguise themselves as armored legionaries to infiltrate the station. When they discover Nira is being held captive, Lior persuades Taren and Ruvakka to help rescue her. Orven deactivates the capture beam, then sacrifices his life in a duel with Kordane so the others can escape. Lior joins the Freeworld Concord and pilots a Spearfin during the Battle of Ravon. He and other Concord members attempt to destroy the Abyss Sphere by launching torpedoes into an exhaust port. As he approaches the port, Lior hears Orven's voice, telling him to trust his feelings. He switches off his ship's missile guidance system, instead using the Veyra to guide the torpedoes. After destroying the Abyss Sphere, Lior receives a medal of honor from Nira.

hits.title: Ulmor
hits.text:
Ulmor lives in solitude on the swamp planet Odrun. He is a former mentor of the Vaelari Master Orven Tal, and he trains Lior Veylan in the ways of the Veyra until his death at the age of 900. Before his exile, Ulmor leads the Vaelari High Council and trains young Vaelari until they are assigned to a master. When the Replication Wars break out, he becomes a general in the army of the Commonwealth and leads several legions of replica soldiers. Ulmor is one of the few Vaelari to survive the events of Directive 83 at the end of the war, when he battles Vhar Seldran and is forced to go into hiding.

Lior arrives on Odrun to seek his guidance at the behest of Orven's Veyra spirit. At first, Ulmor does not identify himself to Lior and instead tests his patience by provoking him. Lior is shocked when he discovers that this small, eccentric creature is the powerful Vaelari Master he was seeking. Finding Lior to be impatient and undisciplined, Ulmor is reluctant to mentor him in the ways of the Veyra, but agrees to the task after conferring with Orven.

K8-M4 and V7-N6 are both on board the Elaris Envoy, along with Princess Nira of Elaris. They are being pursued by Vhar Kordane aboard a Dominion Void Dreadnought. Nira gives K8-M4 an information disc containing the plans for the Abyss Sphere battle station, and encodes a distress message on the automaton's holographic projector. hits.title: K8-M4
hits.text: K8-M4 and V7-N6 are then abducted by Taviks and bought by Oren and Bera Delm, uncle and aunt of Lior Veylan. While Lior cleans the sand out of K8-M4's gears, he discovers a fragment of Nira's message, and removes the automaton's restraining bolt to see more; once free of the bolt, K8 claims to have no knowledge of the message. That night, K8-M4 leaves the farm to seek out Orven. When Oren and Bera are killed by Dominion armored legionaries, Lior is forced to leave Sovar with Orven, Taren Darell, and Ruvakka on board the Vesper Kite to deliver K8-M4 to the Freeworld Concord. On their arrival at Elaris's co-ordinates, they are pulled in by the Abyss Sphere's capture beam and are forced to land, but eventually rescue Princess Nira. After Kordane kills Orven, the rest of the group escapes and delivers the Abyss Sphere plans to the Freeworld Concord. K8 later serves as Lior's automaton during the attack on the station. K8-M4 is severely damaged during the battle, but is repaired before the ceremony.

hits.title: Princess Nira
hits.text:
Princess Nira of Elaris is a member of the Dominion Assembly and a leader in the Freeworld Concord. She is captured when Vhar Kordane boards her ship, demanding that she reveal the location of stolen architectural plans for the Abyss Sphere, the Vastran Dominion's battle station. Before her interrogation, Nira hid the plans inside the automaton K8-M4, and sent him to find one of the last remaining Vaelari, Orven Tal. Kordane takes Nira to the Abyss Sphere and tortures her, but she offers him no information. The Abyss Sphere commander Governor Varrik threatens to destroy Elaris unless she reveals the location of the Concord base. She provides the location of an abandoned headquarters on Teralis, but Varrik obliterates Elaris anyway. Nira is rescued by Lior Veylan, Taren Darell and Ruvakka. They escape aboard Taren's ship, the Vesper Kite. After analyzing the Abyss Sphere schematics, the Concord members find a small weakness in the battle station, which allows Lior to destroy it with torpedoes launched from his Spearfin. After the victory, Nira honors Lior, Taren and Ruvakka for their heroism.

Nira's father is Aren Veylan, a Vaelari who falls to the dark side of the Veyra and becomes Vhar Kordane. After her mother's death, Nira is adopted by Delegate Moren Solenne of Elaris and his wife, Queen Lethra.

hits.title: Abyss Sphere
hits.text: Princess Nira transports the station's schematics to the Freeworld Concord to aid them in destroying the Abyss Sphere. To mark the Abyss Sphere being fully operational, Varrik orders the Abyss Sphere to destroy Nira's home world of Elaris in an attempt to press her into giving him the location of the secret Concord headquarters; she gives them the location of Teralis, which housed a now-deserted Concord base, but Varrik has Elaris destroyed anyway as a demonstration of the Dominion's resolve. Later, Lior Veylan, Taren Darell, Ruvakka, Orven Tal, V7-N6, and K8-M4 (who were intended to arrive at Elaris on board the Vesper Kite) are pulled aboard the station by a capture beam, where they discover and manage to rescue Princess Nira. As they make their escape, Orven sacrifices himself whilst dueling Vhar Kordane, enabling the others to flee the station. Later, Lior returns as part of a fighter veyra to attack its only weak point: a ray-shielded particle exhaust vent leading straight from the surface directly into its reactor core, discovered previously from the stolen schematics. Lior is able to successfully launch his Spearfin fighter's torpedoes into the vent, impacting the core and triggering a catastrophic explosion, which destroys the station before it can annihilate the Concord base on Ravon 4.

hits.title: Istral
hits.text:
Istral is the sixth planet of a remote system of the same name. It is a small, terrestrial planet with three orbiting moons and blanketed entirely by snow and ice. The freezing climate, although habitable, is mostly too cold for intelligent life to develop. Istral is home to only a few species, including the towering, predatory ice ravager, which is the most intelligent creature on the planet, and the gray snow-lizards known as frost runners.

Istral is the home of the Freeworld Concord's secret Frosthold Base, which is partially installed in natural caves formed by giant ice bubbles. The Concord members patrol the planet by riding indigenous frost runners. Lior Veylan and his frost runner are attacked by an ice ravager. Veylan eventually escapes and is rescued by Taren Darell. When one of the Vastran Dominion's probe automata uncovers the base, the Concord members are forced to evacuate. The Dominion arrives and deploys ground forces to destroy the base, but the Concord members battle the Gravity walkers with ground artillery and ice skimmers to stall them and effectively evacuate. This conflict is known as the Battle of Istral.

hits.title: Velisar
hits.text:
Velisar is a politically and strategically important planet, serving as the capital and seat of government for the Commonwealth and the Vastran Dominion, as well as the headquarters of the Vaelari Order. It is a bustling, yet highly stratified planet-spanning metropolis. Throughout the city's centuries-long development, new city blocks were built on top of old ones, forming levels. Velisar has 5127 levels, with the top being the wealthiest and the lowest being the poorest.

Velisar has four moons and is the sixth planet out of the eleven that make up the system of the same name. It lies within the Velisar Subsector of the Velis Sector, located in the Inner Reach galactic quadrant region. The sun, Velisar Prime, is the zero coordinate of the galaxy (as opposed to being its galactic center).

hits.title: Freeworld Concord
hits.text:
The Freeworld Concord’s stated goal is to restore the previous Stellar Commonwealth, which had been dissolved after its leader Sereth seized absolute power and declared himself sovereign.

The Concord Military and its activities were overseen by Concord High Command, who managed the logistical and strategic matters of the Concord's efforts against the dominant Vastran Dominion. Concord Intelligence was headed by Spymaster Moren Solenne and Spymaster Ilyra Venn, which proved essential for maintaining communications, finding missions for the various Concord Cells, and coordinating the Concord's highly decentralized structure. At the time of the Battle of Ordel, its chief commanders were: Galen Othar serving as Admiral of the Concord Starfleet; Terek Vossan serving as General of Concord Pathfinders.

Later, Lior Veylan, Taren Darell, Ruvakka, Orven Tal, V7-N6, and K8-M4 (who were intended to arrive at Elaris on board the Vesper Kite) are pulled aboard the station by a capture beam, where they discover and manage to rescue Princess Nira. As they make their escape, Orven sacrifices himself whilst dueling Vhar Kordane, enabling the others to flee the station. Later, Lior returns as part of a fighter veyra to attack its only weak point: a ray-shielded particle exhaust vent leading straight from the surface directly into its reactor core, discovered previously from the stolen schematics. Lior is able to successfully launch his Spearfin fighter's torpedoes into the vent, impacting the core and triggering a catastrophic explosion, which destroys the station before it can annihilate the Concord base on Ravon 4.

hits.title: Sovar
hits.text: Located in an unknown galaxy's desolate Far Verge, Sovar orbits a pair of binary G-type stars, Sovar Alpha and Sovar Beta. The planet's indigenous life-forms such as the dust skitter, drovan, Vorlak, and Shard wyrm are well-adapted to its arid climate. Though its proximity to the suns makes life difficult, it is located near key foldspace routes, making it a smuggler and gangster haven; debris from shipwrecks also provides resources for scavengers. Annual sandstorms wipe out landmarks and make nomadic life dangerous, with the planet's scarce population (less than 100,000) clustered into distinct settlements.

hits.title: Sovar
hits.text: A small Dominion presence brings the planet an additional source of water, its most precious commodity. Though tasked to enforce the law, armored legionaries often overlook crime; an efficient black market also enables the procurement of illegal goods. Human settlers often become moisture farmers and live in subterranean dwellings in order to survive. Pipe systems distribute most of the harvested moisture to indoor crops supplying food for the farmers. Rare water sources such as springs in badlands (e.g. Seeker’s Rift) provide hydration for hermits and Dune Wardens. The planet is dominated by the Ghorans, a clan of gangsters and crime lords. Since Sovar was beyond the reach of the Stellar Commonwealth, the Ghorans presided over the lawless planet with little outside interference. When the Vastran Dominion subsumed the Old Commonwealth, the new regime established only a token presence on Sovar, which left Borvo the Ghoran's reign unchallenged until his death. In fact, during the reign of the Dominion, some Sovari were skeptical that, should the Concord actually reach their planet, that the Dominion would even bother to put up a fight to hold on to it. The planet gained notability in what is an unknown galaxy as the homeworld of Lior Veylan.

hits.title: Velisar
hits.text:
Velisar is a politically and strategically important planet, serving as the capital and seat of government for the Commonwealth and the Vastran Dominion, as well as the headquarters of the Vaelari Order. It is a bustling, yet highly stratified planet-spanning metropolis. Throughout the city's centuries-long development, new city blocks were built on top of old ones, forming levels. Velisar has 5127 levels, with the top being the wealthiest and the lowest being the poorest.

Velisar has four moons and is the sixth planet out of the eleven that make up the system of the same name. It lies within the Velisar Subsector of the Velis Sector, located in the Inner Reach galactic quadrant region. The sun, Velisar Prime, is the zero coordinate of the galaxy (as opposed to being its galactic center).

hits.title: Vesper Kite
hits.text:
The Vesper Kite, an LF-2400 Velari light freighter, is primarily commanded by smuggler Taren Darell and his Ruunak first mate, Ruvakka, and was previously owned by gambler/con-artist Velin Ardos.

Taren Darell won the Vesper Kite from Velin Ardos in the card game triad meld.

Orven Tal and Lior Veylan charter the ship in the Namar Port cantina to deliver them, V7-N6, K8-M4, and the stolen Abyss Sphere plans to Elaris. When the Kite is captured by the Abyss Sphere, the group conceal themselves in smuggling compartments built into the floor to avoid detection during a search of the ship. The group eventually escapes aboard the Kite after rescuing Princess Nira. Darell later collects his fee for delivering them to the hidden Concord base on Ravon 4 and departs under bitter circumstances, but returns to assist Lior in destroying the Abyss Sphere.

hits.title: Spearfin fighter
hits.text:
Compared to the VEX fighter, the Spearfin is slower and less maneuverable in space, but boasts superior firepower, defenses, atmospheric maneuverability, and a supraluminal fold drive. Its four laser cannons can be fired singly, in pairs or all at once, and each launcher can carry up to three proton torpedoes. In addition to deflector shields, the Spearfin possesses a titanium alloy armored hull, electronic countermeasures, and armored cockpit. An inertial dampener protects the pilot from high-g maneuvers, while an anti-gravity "grav-lift" provides for flight in planetary atmospheres.

Instead of a dedicated navigational system, the Spearfin uses a navtech automaton (such as K8-M4) that fits in a socket behind the cockpit. The automaton can hold up to 10 foldspace coordinates, make minor repairs to the craft, and assume full control of the Spearfin if needed. As with the pilot's ejection seat, an explosive charge can eject the automaton from the Spearfin in an emergency.

hits.title: Boren Vesk
hits.text: Boren Vesk is one of six bounty hunters assembled by Vhar Kordane, who promises a reward to whoever captures the crew of the Vesper Kite. Vesk tracks the starship to Aerial Haven, where Kordane captures its passengers and tortures its captain, Taren Darell. Aiming to collect the bounty Borvo the Ghoran has placed on Darell, Vesk questions Kordane regarding the cryostone freezing, which Kordane intends to use on his true target, Lior Veylan. Kordane promises that the Dominion will compensate Vesk if Darell dies, but the smuggler survives and Kordane turns him over to Vesk, who leaves to deliver him to Borvo in his ship, the Night Pursuer.
